title: axonopus surinamensis
intro: Axonopus surinamensis, commonly known as the Surinam grass, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as wounds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Axonopus surinamensis include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
